err.name: ImageAuthError
err.message: image_auth: private.example refused the pull of private.example/other/x:1 without a login (Error response from daemon: unauthorized: authentication required). A private image is pulled with the registry login of the Nexus source the app was installed from, and only when it lives inside the app's own repository there (e.g. <app repository>/runtime); other sources' logins and other repositories are never used. Set that source's login: aura nexus registry login <source>
